limitations.react: Model chooses check_identity or final; final is not delivery-gated.
limitations.verify_retry: Whole-answer proposals; mandatory identity+expansion check; retry original task.
limitations.residual: Production Agent; gated intermediate rewrites and persistent checked state.
limitations.residual_growth: Identical production Agent plus frozen independently admitted discovery rules.
limitations.budget: Eight model calls per task, same model/parameters/output cap; stop on completion, abstention, schema failure or technical failure. The harness normalizes JSON null to immediate abstention in the production arms.
limitations.discovery: Three sequential model tasks; admission and disk reload are reverified; costs charged separately.
limitations.transfer: No learning; no selective reruns; arm submission order rotates by task, four concurrent workers.
limitations.scoring: Separate exact degree-complete Cartesian-grid oracle, never provided to proposers.
limitations.scope: Handcrafted prospective mechanism pilot; one run, eight tasks, not an established benchmark or SOTA comparison.
limitations.confounds: Schemas, state visibility, mandatory gating and stopping differ intentionally; this does not isolate residual scheduling alone.
limitations.residual_limit: Polynomial adapter has one binary expansion obligation, not structured subterm residuals.
